name: duopore-public-spaced-practice-schedule
description: Turn a start date and your chosen gaps into a clear schedule for study practice.

interface.longDescription: Turn a start date and your chosen gaps into a clear schedule for study practice. Choose the number of days between reviews and add a deadline if you have one. See each review date and any that fall too late. For adults planning their own learning. These are the intervals you choose; the app does not promise better memory or exam results.
defaultPrompt: Plan review dates from this start date and these day gaps.
Which practice dates fall after my exam deadline?

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.
